Director of Engineering - MetaDefender Managed File Transfer
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Director of Engineering — Meta Defender Managed File Transfer

Reports to: VP, Products

Protecting the World’s Critical Infrastructure

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world’s largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.

The Product: MetaDefender Managed File Transfer

MetaDefender Managed File Transfer is OPSWAT’s secure managed file transfer solution, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to move sensitive files safely across enterprise networks and partner boundaries. It embeds OPSWAT’s threat prevention technology — multiscanning, Deep CDR, and DLP — directly into every file flow.

This role owns the engineering for the product across its full range of deployment form factors — air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud environments — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.

About This Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of MetaDefender Managed File Transfer: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped and cross-domain environments to internet-connected and native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.

You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture that the rest of OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products, and lead a distributed team across Romania, Vietnam, and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere, with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead as an AI-first effort: make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
Stay hands-on: remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap: take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the “what to ship” into the “how to build,” and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
Set technical direction (the “how”): drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
Build and lead a high-performance team: recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania, Vietnam, and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
Drive performance-based management: set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
Hold a security-first quality bar: champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
Raise engineering velocity: continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio: establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.
Partner cross-functionally: work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

What We Need From You

Full agentic development experience (required): you have personally run a full agentic, AI-powered SDLC end to end — and have done so in B2B and high-security enterprise environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and assurance requirements are non-negotiable. You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.
A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC: demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.
Proven engineering leadership: 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams (including managing managers/leads) through complex product delivery at scale. You can point to the decisions you made and why.
Performance-based leadership: a track record of building high-performing teams through rigorous, fair performance management — promoting excellence, making timely talent decisions, and reducing or replacing low performers when needed.
Deep technical excellence: strong, current software engineering fundamentals — solid command of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architecture. You can evaluate AI-assisted code with the same rigor as human-authored code. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals; they do not replace them.
Scalable systems experience: a proven history building scalable, distributed solutions — including relational/document databases, cloud-native services, and modern CI/CD systems.
Quality and test discipline: a high bar for tested, maintainable code; you use AI to accelerate test scaffolding, then validate that coverage is real and meaningful.
Distributed-team leadership: demonstrated ability to lead and align engineers across countries and time zones, building trust, clarity, and accountability in a remote/hybrid, multi-country setup.
Talent magnet and clear communicator: you identify strong engineers, make a compelling case for why they should join, and create an environment where they do their best work — and you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without oversimplifying.
Security-conscious by default: operating in critical infrastructure markets means security is never an afterthought; you hold the team to a security-first bar on design, code review, and incident response.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

Domain familiarity: experience with managed file transfer, secure content delivery, data security, or critical infrastructure markets — you understand the trade-offs customers in this space make.
.NET / C# ecosystem: hands-on or managerial experience with .NET Core / C# — enough to evaluate architectural decisions, review PRs credibly, and hire well for the stack.
Cloud-native and containers: experience leading the design or operation of cloud-native SaaS platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — including using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation.
AI context-file authoring: experience writing AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
AI in CI/CD pipelines: familiarity running AI agents inside pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps — not as experiments, but as how the team actually works.
International team experience: a track record of building and maintaining engineering culture and delivery quality across multiple countries and time zones.
Async and high-throughput systems: experience validating concurrency and thread-safety in high-throughput services.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Lead a product trusted by critical infrastructure customers across air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud deployments — the architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
Influence beyond this product: the AI-native patterns you establish will propagate across OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio.
Work from anywhere — a worldwide, remote-friendly role with a preference for the UK, USA, or a location near an OPSWAT-operated country.
Stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
A mandate to build AI-native engineering practices — and the latitude to do it your way.
Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

We're a group of people who fell in love with the future sci-fi promised us, and we're building it into reality. We build hard things. We build them well. And we're just getting started.

Turion is scaling toward production of tens of vehicles per month while running several vehicle development efforts in parallel, and the engineering practices that got us here will not get us there on manual effort alone. The Head of Vehicle Development, Software owns the software layer of how we develop vehicles: the tools, automation, AI, and data infrastructure that let a lean team design, analyze, build, and verify spacecraft at production rate.

You will turn one-off engineering analyses into push-button pipelines, wire our design and systems processes into a connected digital thread, and give every responsible engineer an unfair advantage. This is a player-coach role. You will set the vision and recruit a small, elite team, and you will ship code yourself from day one.

This is a full-time
, exempt position based on-site
at our Irvine, California headquarters.

Responsibilities

Own the roadmap. Define and drive the strategy for vehicle development software across analysis automation, design automation, systems and requirements tooling, applied AI, engineering data infrastructure, and compute.
Build the team. Recruit, lead, and grow the software engineers on this team, set the technical bar, and stay hands-on in architecture and code.
Automate analysis. Drive the conversion of manual thermal, structural, vibration, shock, and environments analyses into parameterized, repeatable pipelines with automated model generation, batch solves, margin tracking, and generated reports.
Automate design and release. Own CAD, ECAD, PDM/PLM, BOM, and engineering release automation, plus clean hand-offs to manufacturing and supply chain.
Systemize systems engineering. Stand up requirements, verification, budget, and trade study tooling so systems engineering runs on live data rather than static documents.
Connect the digital thread. Create a common data layer linking requirements, CAD and ECAD, analysis models, test results, and as-built vehicle configurations, giving one source of truth from concept through on-orbit operations.
Build the compute layer. Stand up the cloud and HPC infrastructure that simulation, data, and AI workloads run on, and keep cost per solve falling.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Productivity
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead teams building AI-assisted engineering workflows. This role will partner with engineering leaders in infrastructure, developer productivity, security, product engineering, ads, machine learning, and senior technical leadership to make AI-native development safe, measurable, scalable, and effective across Reddit.

Reddit is entering a new era of software development. AI and agentic workflows are changing how code is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and shipped. Used well, these tools can help engineers move faster with higher confidence. Used poorly, they can increase complexity, review burden, operational risk, and cost. This role will help Reddit build the path for agentic development: flexible enough for teams to experiment, opinionated enough to protect quality, and measurable enough to prove whether AI is increasing delivered value rather than just activity. Just as importantly, this role will help bring teams along for that change, building trust in new workflows and helping Reddit evolve how we build software together.

Who We Are

The Developer Productivity organization builds the platforms, systems, and workflows that enable Reddit engineers to develop, test, review, deploy, and operate software safely and efficiently at scale. We work across infrastructure, AI tooling, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, code review, and software delivery systems to reduce friction, improve engineering effectiveness, and help teams focus on delivering impact for Reddit users.

As AI and agentic workflows reshape software development, Developer Productivity is helping define how Reddit builds software in the future. We are creating the foundations for AI-native engineering: scalable platforms for LLM access and evaluation, safe agent workflows, intelligent development environments, and measurement systems that help teams understand whether new tools are improving outcomes, not just increasing activity. We partner closely with engineering teams across Reddit to build paved paths that support experimentation while maintaining the quality, reliability, security, and operational standards required to run Reddit at scale.

What You'll Do

You will lead teams across Reddit's Developer Productivity and AI portfolio, spanning agent infrastructure, AI-assisted code review, developer environments, LLM governance, developer tooling, AI workflow measurement, and software delivery automation. You will partner deeply with engineering teams as a technical leader, balancing execution, organizational alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform strategy.

In this role, you will:

Lead and grow high-performing engineering teams focused on AI-native developer productivity, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Developer Productivity and Infrastructure leaders to translate strategy into scalable platforms and engineering roadmaps across code review, agent infrastructure, self-service LLM access, evaluation and observability systems, development environments, and safe agent workflows across the software development lifecycle.
Define and evolve the operating model for AI-native software development, including paved paths, platform adoption strategies, governance models, and engineering standards that enable safe and effective experimentation at scale.
Drive alignment across infrastructure, developer experience, reliability, security, compliance, product engineering, machine learning, and executive stakeholders. You will influence across organizations and create clarity across teams with different priorities and incentives.
Build engineering systems and organizational processes that help teams move from experimentation to durable adoption of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining quality, reliability, and operational safety.
Develop communication and enablement mechanisms that bring engineers and leaders along for the journey, including technical strategy reviews, working groups, training, documentation, rollout plans, and clear narratives that connect workflow change to business and engineering outcomes.
Build and operationalize measurement systems that distinguish real productivity from vanity metrics. Partner with engineering and data teams to define metrics such as design-to-test time, test-to-launch time, review turnaround, change failure rate, time to restore service, AI-authored code quality, AI-assisted pull request load, migration throughput, and developer satisfaction.
Drive AI governance and platform adoption in a way that preserves engineering creativity while ensuring security, cost management, privacy, compliance, and operational safety are built into the development lifecycle.
Use technical judgment to challenge assumptions, identify systemic risks, guide architectural tradeoffs, and help teams make pragmatic decisions across AI tooling, CI/CD, code review, deploy automation, developer environments, and production reliability.
Partner with senior engineering leadership on organizational planning, technical investment strategy, hiring, career development, and long-term platform evolution.

Who You Are

You have 14+ years of experience across software engineering, engineering management, infrastructure, developer tools, platform engineering, AI tooling, or related technical domains, including experience leading engineering teams.
You have managed high-performing engineering teams delivering large-scale technical platforms or infrastructure with executive visibility and cross-functional dependencies. You are comfortable operating with senior leaders while still engaging deeply in technical and operational details.
You have deep fluency in developer productivity systems: CI/CD, code review, testing, deployment, observability, developer environments, internal platforms, or AI-assisted development workflows.
You understand AI and LLM-enabled software development beyond personal productivity. You can reason about agent workflows, governance, evals, telemetry, code quality, review burden, cost controls, and operational risk.
You are highly data-driven, but skeptical of shallow metrics. You know how to build measurement systems that connect workflow improvements to business and engineering outcomes.
You are an exceptional cross-functional leader and communicator. You bring people together, create clarity across organizations, build trust across functions, and translate complex technical and organizational change into clear narratives for engineers, managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You have led meaningful organizational change, not just technical delivery. You know how to shift behavior across teams by listening to concerns, building confidence, and making the desired path easier and more valuable than the status quo.
You care deeply about engineering quality, operational excellence, and developer experience, and you know how to balance speed with long-term maintainability and reliability.
You get things done. You are not satisfied with status reporting, process theater, or activity metrics. You deliver outcomes and help teams understand the difference between motion and impact.
You are pragmatic and iterative. You can introduce structure without slowing teams down, and you know when a paved path should be adopted through value rather than enforcement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading developer productivity, platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, or AI tooling teams at large scale.
Experience with LLM platforms, AI-assisted development tools, agentic workflows, or AI governance in an enterprise engineering environment.
Experience building internal platforms or developer tools where success depends on trust, usability, reliability, and measurable value.
Experience leading organizational transformation, platform adoption, or engineering workflow modernization initiatives across large engineering organizations.
Familiarity with engineering productivity frameworks such as DORA, SPACE, or similar multi-dimensional measurement approaches.
Experience working in fast-moving environments where technical strategy, organizational design, and execution mechanisms are evolving at the same time.

Benefits:

Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
401k with Employer Match
Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
Family Planning Support
Gender-Affirming Care
Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

jobs.description:
Director of Engineering - Executive Leadership Opportunity in Advanced Aerospace Manufacturing

South Gate, CA | On-site

Opportunity Summary

Join an established aerospace and defense manufacturer entering an exciting period of growth, modernization, and operational expansion. The company produces high-precision machined components and engineered manufacturing solutions supporting some of the industry's most demanding aerospace and defense programs. With strong business momentum and continued investment in engineering, automation, and manufacturing technology, this is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of the organization. As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for manufacturing engineering, CNC programming, technical proposal support, process development, tooling strategy, and new product introduction. Working directly with executive leadership, you will drive both day-to-day engineering execution and long-term strategic initiatives including manufacturing technology investments, automation, capital planning, and organizational development. This role is designed for an experienced engineering leader who wants to expand beyond functional management into executive leadership. The successful candidate will play a key role in the company's long-term succession strategy, with the opportunity to assume broader operational and executive responsibilities as the business continues to grow.

About Us

We are a well-established aerospace and defense manufacturer specializing in precision machining, advanced manufacturing, and production of complex hardware for highly regulated industries. Our business combines decades of manufacturing expertise with continued investments in automation, engineering talent, and modern production technologies to support long-term customer partnerships and sustained growth. As our manufacturing capabilities continue to expand, we are building the next generation of leadership that will guide the business through its next phase of growth, operational excellence, and technology adoption.

Job Duties

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organization including manufacturing engineers, CNC programmers, tooling engineers, NPI engineers, and technical sales engineers.
Build and scale the engineering organization by recruiting top technical talent to support continued business growth.
Establish engineering priorities while balancing customer commitments, production schedules, quality objectives, and financial performance.
Partner with executive leadership to develop engineering strategy, organizational plans, and long-term business initiatives.
Support business development efforts by developing manufacturing strategies, technical solutions, cost estimates, tooling plans, and proposal content.
Evaluate manufacturing feasibility, technical risk, and production readiness for new business opportunities.
Lead new product introduction activities from manufacturing planning through production launch and production ramp.
Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM), process development, tooling strategy, process validation, and first article inspection activities.
Coordinate engineering efforts across manufacturing, operations, quality, supply chain, and program management to ensure successful product execution.
Develop and maintain the company's engineering and manufacturing technology roadmap.
Identify and implement investments in advanced manufacturing equipment, automation, robotics, software, and production technologies.
Develop business cases and return-on-investment analyses supporting capital equipment purchases and manufacturing improvements.
Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and lead implementation where they improve quality, throughput, efficiency, or profitability.
Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives across the engineering organization.
Make engineering decisions that balance technical excellence with operational efficiency, manufacturability, customer requirements, and long-term business objectives.
Serve as a strategic leader helping modernize manufacturing capabilities while preparing the organization for continued growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
8+ years of engineering experience within advanced manufacturing.
3+ years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Strong knowledge of CNC machining, precision manufacturing, tooling, manufacturing processes, and production operations.
Experience supporting customer proposals, manufacturing planning, cost estimating, and technical risk assessment.
Demonstrated success leading new product introduction from concept through production.
Experience developing engineering strategies, manufacturing roadmaps, capital investment plans, or operational improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and production process optimization.
Proven leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong business acumen with the ability to balance engineering decisions alongside operational and financial objectives.

Preferred Experience

Aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing experience.
Experience supporting Boeing, Lockheed Martin, RTX, Northrop Grumman, or similar aerospace and defense manufacturing standards.
Experience implementing robotics, automation, or advanced manufacturing technologies within production environments.
Working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or comparable quality management systems.
Experience leading manufacturing modernization or facility expansion initiatives.
Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Master's degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, or Business Administration.

Why Join Us

Join an established aerospace manufacturer experiencing significant growth and long-term business expansion.
Lead the engineering strategy for a business investing heavily in advanced manufacturing, automation, and operational excellence.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization while helping shape the future direction of the company.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Partiful's mission is to cultivate friendships through social events.

We believe events are the most effective way to meet new people and make friends. Our product helps you throw incredible events, starting with memorable party pages that make it easy to plan & communicate with guests — download the app to see how it works!

We're building new ways to streamline planning, connect meaningfully in the real world, and make connections between friends-of-friends. Our ultimate vision is to power everything you do in-person with your friends, eliminating the friction of bringing your most memorable experiences to life. You can read more about our mission in The Washington Post, The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Atlantic, Wirecutter, and USA Today. Partiful was named Google’s Best App of 2024, a Finalist for Apple’s App Store Awards, and Apple’s App of the Day (awarded 4x). In 2025, we were named one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies, one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and named to Inc. Magazine's Best in Business List.

Our company is backed by top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Google Ventures, and advised by the founders of some of the most successful consumer social products ever made.

The Role

We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to build and lead a high-performing engineering org that can ship ambitious product outcomes with speed, quality, and accountability as we scale.

You’ll own the health, output, and growth
of the engineering team — making sure the right people are in the right roles, the management layer is strong, and recruiting, culture, and execution all reinforce each other. This is not
a “headcount first” role: you should be obsessed with motivating and getting maximum leverage out of the current team and be willing to make hard calls when needed. You set the pace by example
— willing to dive into the work, do what it takes during critical moments, and hold the bar high for yourself and the team.

What you’ll do

Build and lead a high-performing engineering organization that can ship ambitious product and infra work with speed, quality, and accountability
Partner closely with the CTO on technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap prioritization; balance short-term product goals with long-term scalability and reliability
Partner closely with the CEO & CTO to communicate company vision and strategy, ensuring the entire engineering team is highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals
Own engineering execution and deadlines: ensure every project has clear goals, scope, owner, and deadlines — and that they’re consistently hit
Introduce lightweight, effective systems for ownership, accountability, and visibility (planning, status, reviews) without weighing the team down in process
Systematically identify bottlenecks and friction in team workflows — from planning and handoffs to QA and releases — and simplify or redesign processes so engineers spend more time on deep work and shipping
Assess and develop existing leads; build a strong middle-management layer (EMs / Leads / Staff ICs) that can scale us from 15 to 40+ engineers
Define, roll out, and maintain a clear career ladder and performance framework for engineers and managers
Build a culture where high performers are energized — people feel real ownership, are recognized and rewarded for impact, and are motivated to do the best work of their careers here
Hold a high bar for performance: celebrate wins and exceptional outcomes; ensure underperformance is identified early and addressed directly, whether via coaching, role changes, or exits
Own engineering recruiting end-to-end with the CTO and People team: set the bar, refine the process, and personally help source, interview, and close top talent
Codify and enforce engineering culture and standards (speed, craftsmanship, ownership, resilience); make excellence the default via code review norms, postmortems, documentation, and technical design practices
Strengthen cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, and Ops so engineering effort is tightly aligned to company goals
Establish and track key metrics for engineering velocity, quality, and recruiting pipeline health, and use them to guide decisions
Work "in the trenches" with the team: we're in the office 3 days a week, with occasional late nights to get the job done

What you’ll bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, with proven leadership of 15–40+ engineers in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment
Direct experience building and scaling an engineering org: hiring, org design, management systems, and performance management
A track record of driving operational excellence in engineering — predictable delivery, clear ownership, and high-quality output
Strong people leadership skills: you’ve hired, leveled, developed, and retained high-performing engineers and managers
Comfort making and executing on hard people decisions with clarity and empathy
Deep experience partnering with a founder/CTO and product leaders on roadmap, architecture, and tradeoffs
Strong recruiting instincts: you’re personally effective at sourcing, assessing, and closing top talent
Clear and concise communication; you create alignment, set context, motivate teams, and make decisions in the face of ambiguity
You’re energized by high-intensity, hands-on building — you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, live close to the work, and model the pace and standards you expect from the team
Nice-to-haves (but not required):
Background in consumer or highly product-centric engineering
Experience managing both product and infra/platform teams
Experience scaling teams in hybrid or in-office environments

What we offer

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
401(k) with company matching
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
OneMedical membership, telehealth, and virtual mental health support
Commuter benefits & contributions towards fitness / wellness (e.g., ClassPass, Citibike)
Flexible PTO and ~14 paid holidays per year
Quarterly stipend to plan your own party and dogfood the product, plus semiannual team offsites
Parental leave
A front-row seat at an early, fast-growing company that cares deeply about product quality, culture, and building something people love

In your application, please include a note on what excites you about Partiful!

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Engineering Services/City Engineer
jobs.description:
The City of Port Angeles seeks a collaborative, strategic, and technically accomplished public works professional to serve as Deputy Director of Engineering Services and City Engineer.

Nature of the Work

Under the administrative direction of the Public Works & Utilities Director, the Deputy Director of
Engineering Services/City Engineer assists in planning, organizing, coordinating, and directing the
engineering services and operations of the Public Works & Utilities Department while serving as
the City’s designated City Engineer. This position provides executive leadership to a dedicated team
responsible for the City’s engineering related services and functions by overseeing the planning, design,
construction, and delivery of major public infrastructure projects.

The Deputy Director plays a key leadership role in advancing the City’s strategic priorities by directing
long-range planning for the Stormwater, Water, and Wastewater Utilities, managing complex capital
improvement programs, providing technical and policy guidance to City leadership, and ensuring
compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations. The position also serves as Acting Public
Works & Utilities Director in the Director’s absence.

Key Responsibilities:

Provide leadership and administrative oversight for the Engineering Services Division, including engineering, and related technical functions.
Assist the Public Works & Utilities Director in planning, organizing, and directing departmental operations, policies, strategic initiatives, and long range infrastructure planning.
Lead the planning, design, construction, and inspection of major public works and utility capital improvement projects.
Develop, administer, and monitor divisional operating and capital budgets, including oversight of the City’s Capital Improvement Program.
Serve as the City’s principal engineering advisor to the Public Works & Utilities Director, Deputy City Manager, City Manager, City Council, Utility Advisory Committee, and other public agencies on engineering, utility, and infrastructure matters.
Prepare and present reports, recommendations, technical analyses, and presentations to City leadership, elected officials, advisory committees, and the public.
Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, engineering standards, and permitting requirements governing public works and utility operations.
Assist in developing ordinances, policies, standards, and procedures that support the effective delivery of engineering and utility services.
Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering staff while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused, and high-performing work environment.
Coordinate engineering activities with other City departments, outside agencies, consultants, contractors, and utility partners to ensure successful project delivery.
Serve as Acting Public Works & Utilities Director during the Director’s absence and perform other related duties as assigned.

Desirable Qualifications:

The successful candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a closely related engineering field from an accredited college or university. Registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) is required.

The ideal candidate will have progressively responsible management experience leading engineering, public works, or utility operations, preferably within a municipal or other public sector organization with
multiple utility systems. Experience overseeing engineering staff, capital improvement programs, resource management, permitting, and public infrastructure projects is highly desirable. Experience administering public works construction contracts and professional services agreements is also preferred. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position may be considered.

The successful candidate must possess a valid Washington State driver’s license at the time of appointment or be able to obtain one within thirty (30) days of hire and maintain a driving record acceptable to the City’s Risk Manager.

Salary and Benefits:

$141,367-$168,976 annually
This position is also eligible for relocation reimbursement up to $10,000.

Other benefits include:
•Up to 3% deferred compensation employer contribution
13 paid holidays
Vacation and sick leave accrual
Medical insurance (12.5% employee-paid premium)
Employer contribution to Health Savings Account
Dental and Vision insurance
Health Care Offset
Employee Assistance Program
Employer-paid life insurance ($50,000 plan)
Long-term disability
Washington State Retirement System (PERS)
40 hours of management leave annually

Why Port Angeles Is For You: 

Located on the northern edge of the Olympic Peninsula along the shores of the Strait of Juan de Fuca, the City of Port Angeles offers a rare combination of dramatic natural beauty and a vibrant, welcoming community. The surrounding peninsula is renowned for its extraordinary diversity—lush temperate rainforests, rugged mountain ranges, pristine rivers, and expansive ocean beaches all within easy reach.

Port Angeles is a modern coastal city with a rich and diverse history, including a strong and visible Native American presence that continues to shape the area’s culture and community life. Residents enjoy a wide array of cultural offerings, from festivals and arts events to music, recreation, and local sporting activities. Educational opportunities are excellent, with highly regarded public schools and Peninsula College offering both two- and four-year degree programs. Outdoor recreation is a defining feature of life in Port Angeles.
Nearby amenities include hot springs, beaches, rivers, and parks, as well as Olympic National Park and the Olympic Discovery Trail— one of the longest continuous trail systems in the United States. The city also serves as an international gateway, with ferry service to Victoria.

Port Angeles benefits from a mild coastal climate, with typical daytime temperatures ranging from the 40s in winter to the 70s in summer, and average annual rainfall of less than 25 inches. To learn more about the community, visit www.cityofpa.us and www.visitportangeles.com.

About NeurOptics

NeurOptics Inc. is the leader in the science of pupillometry. Driven by a passion to help clinicians improve patient outcomes, NeurOptics develops objective, data-driven technologies for critical care nursing, critical care medicine, neurology, neurosurgery, and emergency medicine. The company’s technologies help clinicians evaluate neurological function by providing objective information from the human eye to support critical medical decision-making.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, NeurOptics is represented in the United States and more than 27 countries worldwide. At NeurOptics, we are passionate patient advocates. Helping clinicians improve neurological outcomes is our life’s work.

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering will lead the engineering organization responsible for translating NeurOptics’ next-generation clinical, optical, and algorithmic concepts into robust, manufacturable, compliant medical-device products.

This role owns engineering execution from feasibility assessment and system architecture through product development, production transfer, and sustaining engineering. The position requires a strong systems-level leader who can integrate hardware, software, embedded systems, image processing, signal processing, clinical data workflows, and algorithm implementation into reliable products used in high-acuity clinical environments.

The Director of Engineering will partner closely with the CEO, CTO, VP Innovation, Chief Scientist, VP Operations, Quality/Regulatory, and cross-functional teams to ensure that engineering outputs are technically sound, clinically meaningful, manufacturable, scalable, and compliant with applicable medical-device standards.

Successfully translate new product concepts into clear system architectures, engineering requirements, development plans, and risk-reduction strategies.
Deliver robust, manufacturable, testable, and compliant designs through design controls, verification, validation, and production transfer.
Build and lead a high-performing engineering team capable of executing across hardware, software, algorithms, imaging, signal processing, and sustaining engineering.
Reduce technical risk early through structured feasibility assessment, prototyping, technical reviews, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional decision-making.
Create an engineering culture that balances innovation, execution discipline, quality, clinical relevance, and regulatory rigor.

Core Responsibilities

Own feasibility assessment and system architecture for new and existing product platforms.
Lead engineering development from concept definition through production release and sustaining support.
Define and maintain system-level architecture across hardware, software, embedded systems, data pipelines, image processing, signal processing, and algorithm implementation.
Convert clinical, scientific, and innovation concepts into structured engineering requirements, specifications, architecture, development plans, and verification strategies.
Oversee implementation of image processing, signal processing, clinical algorithms, and related software workflows in collaboration with scientific and clinical stakeholders.
Drive execution across multiple concurrent engineering programs, balancing technical risk, timeline, quality, regulatory requirements, and resource constraints.
Ensure engineering outputs meet applicable quality, regulatory, safety, reliability, cybersecurity, usability, and manufacturability requirements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for technical risks, design trade-offs, implementation decisions, and engineering execution barriers.
Lead design reviews, architecture reviews, root-cause investigations, risk assessments, and corrective engineering actions.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external development partners, consultants, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to achieve project objectives.
Mentor engineering staff and help develop the technical depth, execution discipline, and accountability of the engineering organization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership when needed, while maintaining ownership of system-level execution and cross-functional alignment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
Significant experience leading system-level engineering and product development for complex hardware/software products.
Demonstrated experience taking products from concept, feasibility, and architecture through development, verification, production transfer, and sustaining support.
Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and managing multiple concurrent development programs.
Strong systems-level engineering capability across hardware, software, embedded systems, algorithms, and data workflows.
Ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, and product concepts into structured engineering solutions.
Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, design review, and technical risk-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, scientists, clinicians, engineers, operations, quality, regulatory, and external partners.
Ability to operate effectively with autonomy, ambiguity, urgency, and accountability in a fast-paced medical-device environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in engineering, computer science, biomedical engineering, optics, imaging, signal processing, or a related field.
Experience in medical-device development under FDA design controls and ISO 13485 quality systems.
Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601-1, IEC 62304, and related medical-device standards.
Experience with optical sensing, imaging systems, physiological monitoring, neurocritical care technologies, or other clinically oriented measurement systems.
Experience with image processing, signal processing, machine learning implementation, clinical algorithms, or algorithm deployment into regulated products.
Knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, LLM-enabled development workflows, and algorithm development would be highly desirable, particularly where these tools support clinical data analysis, product intelligence, engineering productivity, or regulated algorithm implementation.
Experience working with contract manufacturers, external engineering partners, component suppliers, and manufacturing transfer teams.
Experience building engineering processes, technical documentation systems, design review discipline, and scalable engineering-team structure.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Productivity
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead teams building AI-assisted engineering workflows. This role will partner with engineering leaders in infrastructure, developer productivity, security, product engineering, ads, machine learning, and senior technical leadership to make AI-native development safe, measurable, scalable, and effective across Reddit.

Reddit is entering a new era of software development. AI and agentic workflows are changing how code is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and shipped. Used well, these tools can help engineers move faster with higher confidence. Used poorly, they can increase complexity, review burden, operational risk, and cost. This role will help Reddit build the path for agentic development: flexible enough for teams to experiment, opinionated enough to protect quality, and measurable enough to prove whether AI is increasing delivered value rather than just activity. Just as importantly, this role will help bring teams along for that change, building trust in new workflows and helping Reddit evolve how we build software together.

Who We Are

The Developer Productivity organization builds the platforms, systems, and workflows that enable Reddit engineers to develop, test, review, deploy, and operate software safely and efficiently at scale. We work across infrastructure, AI tooling, developer environments, CI/CD, observability, code review, and software delivery systems to reduce friction, improve engineering effectiveness, and help teams focus on delivering impact for Reddit users.

As AI and agentic workflows reshape software development, Developer Productivity is helping define how Reddit builds software in the future. We are creating the foundations for AI-native engineering: scalable platforms for LLM access and evaluation, safe agent workflows, intelligent development environments, and measurement systems that help teams understand whether new tools are improving outcomes, not just increasing activity. We partner closely with engineering teams across Reddit to build paved paths that support experimentation while maintaining the quality, reliability, security, and operational standards required to run Reddit at scale.

What You'll Do

You will lead teams across Reddit's Developer Productivity and AI portfolio, spanning agent infrastructure, AI-assisted code review, developer environments, LLM governance, developer tooling, AI workflow measurement, and software delivery automation. You will partner deeply with engineering teams as a technical leader, balancing execution, organizational alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform strategy.

In this role, you will:

Lead and grow high-performing engineering teams focused on AI-native developer productivity, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Developer Productivity and Infrastructure leaders to translate strategy into scalable platforms and engineering roadmaps across code review, agent infrastructure, self-service LLM access, evaluation and observability systems, development environments, and safe agent workflows across the software development lifecycle.
Define and evolve the operating model for AI-native software development, including paved paths, platform adoption strategies, governance models, and engineering standards that enable safe and effective experimentation at scale.
Drive alignment across infrastructure, developer experience, reliability, security, compliance, product engineering, machine learning, and executive stakeholders. You will influence across organizations and create clarity across teams with different priorities and incentives.
Build engineering systems and organizational processes that help teams move from experimentation to durable adoption of AI-assisted workflows while maintaining quality, reliability, and operational safety.
Develop communication and enablement mechanisms that bring engineers and leaders along for the journey, including technical strategy reviews, working groups, training, documentation, rollout plans, and clear narratives that connect workflow change to business and engineering outcomes.
Build and operationalize measurement systems that distinguish real productivity from vanity metrics. Partner with engineering and data teams to define metrics such as design-to-test time, test-to-launch time, review turnaround, change failure rate, time to restore service, AI-authored code quality, AI-assisted pull request load, migration throughput, and developer satisfaction.
Drive AI governance and platform adoption in a way that preserves engineering creativity while ensuring security, cost management, privacy, compliance, and operational safety are built into the development lifecycle.
Use technical judgment to challenge assumptions, identify systemic risks, guide architectural tradeoffs, and help teams make pragmatic decisions across AI tooling, CI/CD, code review, deploy automation, developer environments, and production reliability.
Partner with senior engineering leadership on organizational planning, technical investment strategy, hiring, career development, and long-term platform evolution.

Who You Are

You have 14+ years of experience across software engineering, engineering management, infrastructure, developer tools, platform engineering, AI tooling, or related technical domains, including experience leading engineering teams.
You have managed high-performing engineering teams delivering large-scale technical platforms or infrastructure with executive visibility and cross-functional dependencies. You are comfortable operating with senior leaders while still engaging deeply in technical and operational details.
You have deep fluency in developer productivity systems: CI/CD, code review, testing, deployment, observability, developer environments, internal platforms, or AI-assisted development workflows.
You understand AI and LLM-enabled software development beyond personal productivity. You can reason about agent workflows, governance, evals, telemetry, code quality, review burden, cost controls, and operational risk.
You are highly data-driven, but skeptical of shallow metrics. You know how to build measurement systems that connect workflow improvements to business and engineering outcomes.
You are an exceptional cross-functional leader and communicator. You bring people together, create clarity across organizations, build trust across functions, and translate complex technical and organizational change into clear narratives for engineers, managers, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You have led meaningful organizational change, not just technical delivery. You know how to shift behavior across teams by listening to concerns, building confidence, and making the desired path easier and more valuable than the status quo.
You care deeply about engineering quality, operational excellence, and developer experience, and you know how to balance speed with long-term maintainability and reliability.
You get things done. You are not satisfied with status reporting, process theater, or activity metrics. You deliver outcomes and help teams understand the difference between motion and impact.
You are pragmatic and iterative. You can introduce structure without slowing teams down, and you know when a paved path should be adopted through value rather than enforcement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading developer productivity, platform engineering, infrastructure modernization, or AI tooling teams at large scale.
Experience with LLM platforms, AI-assisted development tools, agentic workflows, or AI governance in an enterprise engineering environment.
Experience building internal platforms or developer tools where success depends on trust, usability, reliability, and measurable value.
Experience leading organizational transformation, platform adoption, or engineering workflow modernization initiatives across large engineering organizations.
Familiarity with engineering productivity frameworks such as DORA, SPACE, or similar multi-dimensional measurement approaches.
Experience working in fast-moving environments where technical strategy, organizational design, and execution mechanisms are evolving at the same time.

Who We Are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI — real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

Lead a team of 6 engineers owning end-to-end observability across the company's infrastructure, including logs, metrics, traces, and event-based monitoring
Own the roadmap for our observability and cost initiative independently, no PM or TPM support, meeting directly with engineering managers across the company to identify pain points and design end-to-end solutions
Drive down time to detect and time to mitigate for production incidents across a system where a single request can traverse 60+ services

Maintain and grow a highly cost-efficient observability stack (currently running at a fraction of comparable third-party tooling costs)
Represent the technical state of your domain in real time, speaking confidently to feasibility, scope, and timelines for any ask without needing to defer to others
Stay hands-on (roughly a third of your time), jumping in to unblock the team when needed, using AI tools to analyze issues and surface insights, without sitting on the critical path for delivery

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
TAF Carbon has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about engineering and sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s materials.

We are seeking a Director of Engineering who has lived the journey from lab bench to production floor, to join our team working directly with the Director of Research and Development and the leadership team. You will lead our Process Scale-Up & Manufacturing effort, bridging between our world-class R&D scientists and the industrial manufacturing partners who will bring our carbon foam materials to commercial scale. This is a hands-on, technically deep leadership role for someone who finds equal satisfaction in rigorous process analysis and in building the systems and relationships that make manufacturing actually work. This role grows with the company. Near-term, you will be driving industrialization and process control. Over time, you will contribute to new product development from the process and tooling side, and to the early foundations of TAF Carbon's own manufacturing capabilities.

This role is part of the team that services the entire Endeavour ecosystem and contributes to the overall health and success of the organization.

The Director of Engineering needs to be agile, professional, and comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team. They are a born problem solver and highly self-motivated to identify and address engineering challenges.

TAF Carbon is highly selective about the people we bring on board because our ecosystem depends on it. Change happens quickly here, and we must maintain a strong team of honest, communicative, collaborative, open-minded, strategic, reliable, and driven team members. We seek ultra-creative performers with self-awareness, a sense of humility, and a hunger to make a positive impact in the world. Endeavour offers flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value. Our team is the heart of the ecosystem. We’re a diverse group of bright, passionate, dedicated people, working together to make a real difference. Are you ready to join the journey?

Key Responsibilities

Include But Are Not Limited To

Process Scale-Up & Industrialization

Lead the translation of laboratory and pilot-scale carbon foam processes into robust, reproducible industrial manufacturing operations to take our material through testing and certification, prototyping, and product commercial launch.
Hands-on engineering and problem solving in a fast-growing start-up environment.
Define and implement process control and improvement frameworks — including 6 Sigma, SPC and MSA — that establish and sustain process capability across manufacturing environments.
Drive continuous improvement in process efficiency, energy performance, heating uniformity, cost of goods and time to market.
Develop and evaluate innovative approaches to mold design, heating technology, and process configuration that enable scalable, high-throughput production.
Establish and maintain high engineering standards, including documentation, design review processes, and technical governance

Manufacturing Partner Development

Identify, qualify, and develop long-term technical relationships with external manufacturing partners.
Serve as TAF Carbon's primary technical interface with manufacturing operations, ensuring alignment on process requirements, quality standards, and scale-up milestones.
Collaborate with R&D teammates to translate research outcomes into manufacturable processes and clear manufacturing inputs, streamlined processes, to reduce time to market.

Team & Organization

Mentor and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and pragmatic problem-solving.
Support project planning, prioritization, and budgeting in alignment with organizational goals and timelines.
Partner with leadership on strategic product and manufacturing roadmaps across all phases of commercial development.
Model culture of demanding excellence, scientific rigor, problem solving and a daily irreverence to big company corporate culture.

Longer-Term

Lead engineering contributions to new product development and cost reduction from the process and tooling side.
Contribute to early planning and capability-building for TAF Carbon's future manufacturing assets.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships, supporting tailored product solutions and long-term partnerships.

Skills & Requirements

Education / Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering (or related field).
10+ years of progressive engineering experience in industry with 3+ years in a leadership or management role.
Demonstrated track record taking a material or chemical process from lab or pilot scale to industrial production — you have done this, not just supported it.
Deep working knowledge of foamed materials and the industrial processes used to make them: polymer foams, carbon foams, ceramic foams, or closely analogous materials.
Hands-on experience with mold design and molding processes, including thermal analysis, dead mass minimization, and scale-up.
Experience designing or improving industrial heating systems — convective, or other non-conventional approaches are a strong plus.
Experience working with toll manufacturers or contract manufacturers as a technical owner, not just a customer.
Proven expertise in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), and process capability (Cpk, Ppk) — you use these instinctively, not on request.
Expertise with Design of Experiments (DOE) for process optimization.
Experience with continuous or semi-continuous manufacturing line concepts (belt press, or equivalent) is a strong plus.
Experience with controlled atmosphere processing and/or high-temperature industrial environments preferred.
Experience in gas handling, exhaust treatment and waste heat collection and re-use is a plus.
Proven track record driving product qualification, regulatory certification and new product introduction.

Specific Skills / Abilities

You know the difference between a research result and a manufacturable process, and you say so when you see it.
Strong process and systems mindset — experience implementing design control, setting and meeting specifications, and moving product from lab to pilot to prototype to full manufacturing.

Description

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines is a suite of fully managed, high-performance analytics services built on popular open-source frameworks, enabling customers to process, analyze, and derive insights from massive datasets with speed, flexibility, and cost efficiency. Open Data Analytics Engines make it easy for organizations to run petabyte-scale analytics using familiar open-source tools without the operational burden of managing infrastructure.

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines encompasses services purpose-built for large-scale data processing, interactive querying, real-time streaming, and machine learning workloads. The platform leverages open-source engines such as Apache Spark, Presto/Trino, Apache Flink, and Apache Hive, delivering seamless integration with the broader AWS ecosystem. Compute and storage are decoupled, enabling elastic scaling, fine-grained cost optimization, and support for diverse data lake architectures.

As Director of Engineering for Open Data Analytics Engines, you will lead a group of top talent in advancing the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, features, and performance. You'll drive the design, development, and operation of next-generation open-source analytics services on AWS, shaping the future of how customers run large-scale queries in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities

Grow and lead a software development organization responsible for building key AWS analytics services based on open-source engines.

Drive the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of managed analytics services spanning batch processing, interactive queries, and real-time streaming.

Own the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, and performance — setting the direction for how AWS advances the state of the art in open-source analytics.

Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.

Work with senior executives to develop business targets and resource requirements, influence technical and business strategy, hire talented engineers and managers, and conceive innovative new solutions for customers.

Leading the Open Data Analytics Engines team gives you the opportunity to:

Work on industry-defining products in the rapidly evolving open-source data analytics space

Solve challenging problems in query planning and optimization, distributed query execution, stream processing, resource scheduling, and performance at cloud scale

Build products that deliver the power of open-source analytics with the reliability, security, and ease-of-use customers expect from AWS

Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for the future of open-source analytics on AWS

Experience developing and deploying cloud-based analytics technology, particularly services built on open-source frameworks (Spark, Presto/Trino, Flink, Hive)

Deep knowledge of query planning and optimization, whether gained through distributed query engines or relational databases along with resource scheduling, data lake architectures, and performance tuning at petabyte scale

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Hinge Health is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a software engineering team inside Hardware R&D, focused on the software systems behind a connected medical device experience. This role sits at the intersection of consumer software, connected devices, clinical workflows, and regulated product delivery. You will own a single, high-complexity engineering team that spans mobile, backend, BLE, and hardware-adjacent software, and will be responsible for building a platform that is reliable, compliant, and adaptable enough to support rapid product iteration in a demanding domain.

You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, Regulatory, Hardware Engineering, Data, Member Support, and Quality/Compliance teams to define strategy, ship high-quality products, and ensure the device experience is safe, scalable, and delightful for our members end to end.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

Build a deep understanding of our device ecosystem, including FDA-regulated device software, BLE connectivity, mobile and backend platforms, and the clinical and operational workflows that support them.
Establish clear team priorities, execution rhythms, and ways of working, including backlog quality, sprint planning, delivery goals, and retrospectives.
Develop strong partnerships with Product, Clinical, Regulatory, Hardware Engineering, Data, Member Support, and Quality/Compliance counterparts to ensure alignment on goals, constraints, and quality expectations.

In your first 6 months:

Orchestrate large cross-functional programs that span device, mobile, backend, and operations, proactively uncovering corner cases and non-functional risks (reliability, security, performance, scalability).
Drive technical strategy across mobile, backend, device-control, and BLE surfaces so the platform can support both rapid product iteration and long-term maintainability.
Establish strong quality and compliance practices for regulated software, including structured review points with regulatory and quality partners, release gating, tech debt paydown plans, and operational feedback loops.
Lead a team that owns production health in an on-call, continuous delivery environment, improving incident response, observability, and reliability over time.

In your first year:

Translate member pain points, support signals, and product goals into engineering investments that materially improve reliability, reduce support burden, and strengthen the member experience for our device products.
Lead the software roadmap in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders, balancing member experience, technical quality, operational reliability, and regulatory constraints across the platform.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers and emerging technical leaders, building a high-performance, high-accountability culture within a complex and high-ambiguity remit.
Contribute beyond your immediate team through interview design, leveling clarity, process improvements, and broader engineering stewardship across Hardware R&D and the wider engineering organization.

Who You Are

You are an experienced engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of consumer software, connected devices, and regulated product delivery, and you are comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-accountability environments.
You are a strong systems thinker who can reason across mobile apps, backend services, BLE/device-control flows, and operational workflows, making clear time-versus-cost tradeoffs for stakeholders.
You are a builder of teams: you hire, coach, and develop engineers and emerging leaders, and you create a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and high standards for quality and compliance.
You are a trusted cross-functional partner who collaborates deeply with Product, Clinical, Regulatory, Hardware, Data, and Operations to deliver outcomes, not just ship features.
You are comfortable owning production health and operational excellence in an on-call, continuous delivery environment, and you use data, telemetry, and support signals to continuously improve the system.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience leading and managing engineering teams, including managing 5+ direct reports through hiring, coaching, and performance management.
Experience delivering production software for connected devices, BLE-enabled systems, device-control flows, or in close partnership with firmware and hardware teams.

Experience with healthcare, HIPAA, GDPR, FDA-regulated products, or other software in regulated environments.
Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs in environments with high quality, reliability, or compliance expectations.
Familiarity with modern mobile, backend, and platform systems, for example technologies such as React Native, Python, TypeScript, GraphQL, Docker, AWS, Postgres, Redis, or comparable systems.
Experience building test infrastructure, simulation layers, or developer productivity tooling for complex, distributed systems.
Experience leading teams that own production health in an on-call, continuous delivery environment.
Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or engineering workflows thoughtfully in product development.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office. We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Build and improve the tools, workflows, and platform capabilities that help engineers develop, test, validate, and ship software more effectively.

WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
Role Overview

Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Loyalty product that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP).
Reporting to Sr. Director, Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core loyalty features. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.
Zeta Loyalty helps brands move beyond static loyalty programs with intelligent experiences designed to deepen engagement. The next gen Zeta Loyalty platform is envisioned to be AI-powered and agentic.
This is a technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable Loyalty product capabilities at scale.
Loyalty Product Mission

Zeta Loyalty provides a configurable program definition, member foundation, reference data, rules engine, and offer capabilities required to launch enterprise grade loyalty programs.
Rather than simply managing points, this product creates a flexible loyalty platform that enables brands to define their program, reward customer behaviors, and evolve their loyalty strategy without requiring custom engineering.
The key mission of the product is tightly integrating with other services of the ZMP, such as identity, events, messaging and seamlessly executing the loyalty program rules based on user behavior. Additionally, there is an urgent need to integrate Loyalty with AthenaOS, Zeta’s AI-powered assistant, to bring predictive intelligence, real-time activation, conversational AI into the loyalty domain.
Scope of Ownership

Own the complete Loyalty product suite, which includes, but not limited to:
Customizable loyalty programs
Configurable reward rules
Flexible tiering structure
Reward points tracking
Tight Integration with system notification & user messaging frameworks
Omnichannel support
Unified ZMP Identity
Unified ZMP Analytics

Technical Leadership

Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned domains.
Translate product strategy into executable engineering roadmaps.
Participate in quarterly planning and deliver the workloads on a timely manner, with high quality
Drive technical design for services, APIs, schemas, background jobs.
Review designs and ensure alignment with platform architecture and engineering standards.
Identify scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability risks.
Champion reusable solutions and eliminate unnecessary duplication across different features.
